Charles.clueText: Talk to Charles at Port Piscarilius.

Blue Moon Inn.clueText: Talk to the cook in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.

Hairdresser.clueText: Talk to the barber in the Falador barber shop.

Bartender (Rusty Anchor Inn).clueText: Talk to the bartender of the Rusty Anchor in Port Sarim.

Morgan.clueText: Talk to Morgan in his house at Draynor Village.

Doris.clueText: Talk to the mother of a basement dwelling son.

Squire.clueText: Talk to the Squire in the White Knights' castle in Falador.

Wayne.clueText: Talk to Wayne at Wayne's Chains in Falador.

Zeke.clueText: Talk to Zeke in Al Kharid.

Lighthouse.clueText: Go to this building to be illuminated, and check the drawers while you are there.

Donovan the Family Handyman.clueText: Speak to Donovan, the Family Handyman.

Abbot Langley.clueText: 'A bag belt only?', he asked his balding brothers.

General Hining.clueText: A general who sets a 'shining' example.

Miner Magnus.clueText: Come have a cip with this great soot covered denizen.

General Bentnoze.clueText: Generally speaking, his nose was very bent.

Saniboch.clueText: Gold I see, yet gold I require. Give me 875 if death you desire.

Brother Kojo.clueText: He knows just how easy it is to lose track of time.

Ellena.clueText: I watch the sea. I watch you fish. I watch your tree.

Hamid.clueText: Identify the back of this over-acting brother. (He's a long way from home.)

Gerrant.clueText: If a man carried my burden, he would break his back. I am not rich, but leave silver in my track. Speak to the keeper of my trail.

Head chef.clueText: In the city where merchants are said to have lived, talk to a man with a splendid cape, but a hat dropped by goblins.

Wilough.clueText: My name is like a tree, yet it is spelt with a 'g'. Come see the fur which is right near me.

Examiner.clueText: Often sought out by scholars of histories past, find me where words of wisdom speak volumes.

Gnome trainer.clueText: 'Small shoe.' Often found with rod on mushroom.

Sir Vyvin.clueText: Hopefully this set of armour will help you to keep surviving.

Oziach.clueText: The keeper of Melzars...Spare? Skeleton? Anar?

Guardian mummy.clueText: The King's magic shouldn't be wasted by me.

Wizard Mizgog.clueText: The magic of 4 colours, an early experience you could learn. The large beast caged up top, rages, as his demised kin's loot now returns.

Zul-Cheray.clueText: The mother of the reptilian sacrifice.

Father Aereck.clueText: A reck you say; let's pray there aren't any ghosts.

Mawrth.clueText: Has no one told you it is rude to ask a lady her age?

Barker.clueText: His bark is worse than his bite.

Kamfreena.clueText: I am the one who watches the giants. The giants in turn watch me. I watch with two while they watch with one. Come seek where I may be.

Candle maker.clueText: I burn between heroes and legends.

Nardah.clueText: I live in a deserted crack collecting soles.

Dominic Onion.clueText: 'See you in your dreams' said the vegetable man.

Aris.clueText: Varrock is where I reside, not the land of the dead, but I am so old, I should be there instead. Let's hope your reward is as good as it says, just 1 gold one and you can have it read.

Daga.clueText: With a name like that, you'd expect a little more than just a few scimitars.

Funbo.clueText: With drinks and dwarves I make my way, upon my head a glass will stay.

Veteran boat squire.clueText: You must be 100 to play with me.

Wizard Cromperty.clueText: A chisel and hammer reside in his home, strange for one of magic. Impress him with your magical equipment.

Jorral.clueText: Buried beneath the ground, who knows where it's found. Lucky for you, A man called Jorral may have a clue.

Viggora.clueText: Come brave adventurer, your sense is on fire. If you talk to me, it's an old god you desire.

Biblia.clueText: Darkness wanders around me, but fills my mind with knowledge.

Ghommal.clueText: The doorman of the Warriors' Guild wishes to be impressed by how strong your equipment is.

Juna.clueText: Here, there are tears, but nobody is crying. Speak to the guardian and show off your alignment to balance.

Key Master.clueText: My life was spared but these voices remain, now guarding these iron gates is my bane.

Piles.clueText: One of several rhyming brothers, in business attire with an obsession for paper work.

Robin.clueText: Robin wishes to see your finest ranged equipment.

Lovada.clueText: She's small but can build both literally and figuratively.

Mage of Zamorak.clueText: Where safe to speak, the man who offers the pouch of smallest size wishes to see your alignment.
